title: 越……越 in Chinese: "The More... the More" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: How to use 越……越 (yuè... yuè) for "the more... the more" and 越来越 for "more and more" in Chinese: word order, common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: How to Say "The More... the More" with 越……越
lede: 越 (yuè) is used in pairs. 越 A 越 B means "the more A, the more B": as one thing grows, so does the other. 越来越 means "more and more", for something that keeps changing over time.

paras: Subject + 越 + verb + 越 + adjective.
With one subject, the first 越 goes before the verb and the second before the result. 雨越下越大 says that the longer it rains, the heavier it gets. 越 always comes after the subject, never before it.

examples.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

examples.py: Hànyǔ yuè xué yuè yǒu yìsi.
examples.en: The more you learn Chinese, the more interesting it gets.

paras: Subject 1 + 越 + A, subject 2 + 越 + B.
Each part can have its own subject. Put each 越 after its subject.

examples.py: Nǐ yuè shuō, tā yuè bù gāoxìng.
examples.en: The more you say, the less happy he gets.

examples.zh: 东西越便宜，买的人越多。
examples.py: Dōngxi yuè piányi, mǎi de rén yuè duō.
examples.en: The cheaper something is, the more people buy it.

paras: Subject + 越来越 + adjective (+ 了).
越来越 says that something keeps changing as time goes by. It goes before an adjective, or before verbs of feeling such as 喜欢. The sentence often ends with 了, because it describes a change.

examples.py: Tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng le.

examples.zh: 我越来越喜欢这个城市了。
examples.py: Wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuan zhège chéngshì le.
examples.en: I like this city more and more.

examples.zh: 学汉语的人越来越多了。
examples.py: Xué Hànyǔ de rén yuè lái yuè duō le.
examples.en: More and more people are learning Chinese.

paras: 越 already means "more", so don't add 很, 非常 or 太 after it. 天气越来越很冷 is wrong; say 天气越来越冷了. The other common mistake is to forget the second 越: 他越走慢 should be 他越走越慢.

examples.py: Tā de Hànyǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo le.
examples.en: His Chinese is getting better and better.

worksheet.title: 越……越 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 越……越 worksheet for HSK 3: 16 exercises (越 or 越来越, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 越 or 越来越
exercises.instructions: Write 越 or 越来越 in each gap.

items.en: I like my job more and more.
The more I write this character, the better it looks.
More and more people are coming to China on holiday.

items.zh: 这个问题我越想＿＿不明白。
items.en: The more I think about this question, the less I understand it.
My little sister is getting prettier and prettier.
The more I watch this film, the more I like it.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: The snow is getting heavier and heavier.
My health is getting better and better.
The more he thought about it, the happier he got.
The earlier you go, the better.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: Flats and houses are getting more and more expensive.
The more she sang, the better she sounded.
The more he drinks, the more he wants to drink.
